title: Frozen stability margin after resistive load shedding: data and code
description: Data and code accompanying the manuscript on the decision-induced bias of frozen small-signal margins after resistive load shedding in islanded grid-forming microgrids with constant power loads (prepared for submission to Sustainable Energy, Grids and Networks). From v1.5 the repository carries the supplementary archives exactly as prepared for submission: Supplementary Material S1 (model and test code, fixed protocols, sealed outputs with hash lists, post-hoc analyses and the development, p92, figures and p93 additions), S3 (independent offline numerical models and Virtual HIL captures; offline software validation only) and S4 (timing benchmark, pre-registered port-reference/branch-tracking/decomposition analysis, Virtual HIL direction-study records), each with a standard-library integrity check. Earlier files are kept for the record. See README.md and SHA256SUMS.
